sub_tasks.desc: coder Agent: Implement OAuth2 client configurations for Firebase, Google, and Facebook using Quarkus OIDC extension with @ConfigMapping for provider credentials. Store client secrets in GCP Secret Manager with environment variable injection.

coder Agent: Create social authentication service with token exchange and user profile mapping. Implement idempotent user creation/update using provider+provider_id unique constraint. Validate OAuth2 tokens against provider endpoints to prevent token injection.
tester Agent: Write unit tests for OAuth2 configuration and token validation. Mock provider endpoints to simulate token exchange flows. Verify error handling for invalid tokens and provider outages.

coder Agent: Implement JWT token provider with tenant_id and role claims. Use RSA256 signatures with keys rotated every 90 days. Include tenant_id claim from user's center assignment for multi-tenancy.

coder Agent: Create authentication filter for JWT validation on protected endpoints. Validate token signature and expiration using jjwt library. Reject tokens missing required claims (tenant_id, role).

tester Agent: Test token generation and validation with edge cases. Verify token expiration after 15 minutes and refresh token after 7 days. Test token rejection for invalid signatures and missing claims.

coder Agent: Create responsive login form with email/password and OAuth2 provider buttons. Implement real-time validation for email format and password strength. Include Firebase, Google, Facebook OAuth2 buttons with provider logos.

coder Agent: Build registration form with terms acceptance and validation. Enforce password complexity: 8+ chars, uppercase, lowercase, number, special char. Require terms checkbox and provide link to terms document.
coder Agent: Implement authentication context and token management. Store JWT tokens in secure HTTP-only cookies. Implement automatic token refresh before expiration.
reviewer Agent: Review authentication service for security vulnerabilities. Verify no hardcoded secrets or weak algorithm configurations. Ensure all database queries use parameterized statements.
doc Agent: Create authentication architecture documentation. Document OAuth2 flow diagrams and JWT claim structure. Include setup instructions for each social provider.
